page: Microsoft Azure L160iaos_v5 is an isolated, x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the Laosv5 family. It features 160 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD processor and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is equipped with 1040.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 6.5 GB per core.

A defining characteristic of this server is its massive local storage capacity, featuring 138,239 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. The instance is also Premium Storage capable, making it highly suitable for I/O-intensive operations. It does not include any GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

While benchmark data is not available for this specific configuration, the combination of 160 dedicated vCPUs, over a terabyte of RAM, and massive NVMe storage positions it as a high-density resource option. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the hardware profile represents a premium tier designed for massive scale, where the cost is justified by the extreme local storage capacity and isolated compute resources. This server is optimized for large-scale databases, big data analytics, data warehousing, and enterprise-grade transactional workloads requiring high-throughput local storage.
